scientific_integrity: The labelled normal form and labelled counts were established in earlier research and are cited as premises; new assertions concern isomorphism types, stabilizer groups, unlabelled ideal-orbit sequences, and their exact counts. Self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Only complete two-level finite intuitionistic orders with p,q>=2; counts isomorphism classes under order-and-relation isomorphisms, not bisimulation or theories. Nonstandard novelty requires independent literature checking.
title: Isomorphism classes and automorphism groups of finite two-level S4bI frames
